basic_details.short_information: This is the MHRB recruitment for Lecturer posts in the Institute of Pharmacy attached to Government Medical Colleges. The notice is dated 26 November 2026. The official notification does not specify an exam pattern or a syllabus.

application_fee.details: The fee is to be deposited through Treasury Challan in the Head of Account "0210-Medical and Public Health-01-Urban Health Services-800-Other Receipt". Alternatively, it can be deposited online through the Government Receipt Accounting System (GRAS), website https://assamegras.gov.in. The notice says no other mode of deposit is accepted and the fees are not refundable. A printed copy of the Treasury Challan generated through GRAS is to be submitted at the time of interview, and the post applied for may be written in the Remarks column.

age_limit.age_details: Not less than 21 years and not more than 38 years as on 01/01/2026
age_limit.details: A candidate should not be less than 21 years and not more than 38 years of age as on 01/01/2026. The upper age limit is relaxable as below, if applicable.

qualification.education_qualification: First class in both B. Pharm and M. Pharm or First class in Pharm.D from a PCI recognized institution; or First class in B. Pharm with 3 years of teaching and research experience
qualification.details: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 57,700/- to Rs. 1,82,400/- PM (Academic Level-10) plus other allowances as admissible under Rules
salary_details.details: Other allowances are payable as admissible under Rules. The notice does not name individual allowances.

selection_process: The selection procedure will be notified later by issuing a Notice. The Board will decide the procedure for selection on the basis of the number of applications received. The notice mentions document verification and a Viva-Voce/Interview in its terms
but it does not state the stages of selection.
how_to_apply: Visit the website https://nhm.assam.gov.in, which applicants are advised to do from 02/12/2026.
Submit the online application, with photograph and signature, so that the form is complete in every respect.
Do not upload testimonials or certificates with the online application; the notice says none need to be submitted at that stage.
Deposit the fee, if applicable to the category, through Treasury Challan or through GRAS (https://assamegras.gov.in).
Ensure the online application is received by 16/12/2026.
Candidates already in government service, a government owned undertaking, similar organizations/Corporations/boards or private employment may apply with intimation to the present employer.
The notice does not describe the online form steps in more detail.
Original testimonials regarding educational qualification, date of birth, caste, PWD, Treasury Challan, working experience etc., with the application form, at the time of interview.
Self-attested copies of all testimonials/certificates, submitted to the Board at the time of interview.
Printed copy of the Treasury Challan generated through GRAS, at the time of interview.
"No Objection Certificate" from the present employer, for those in government or private employment, at the time of document verification before Viva-Voce/Interview.
Release order at the time of joining, for those in employment.

content_sections.heading: MHRB Lecturer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice announces 13 posts of Lecturer. The Board states that the number of vacancies may vary due to administrative exigencies in due course of time. RFW means Reserved for Women. The break-up printed in the notice is below. The number of posts reserved for persons with disability is printed as 0. The notice states the disability categories that may be considered: orthopedically handicapped with at least one arm and one leg, low vision, hearing handicapped and blind, if the candidate can perform with aids and appliances.

content_sections.text: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

faq.question: Q1. How many Lecturer vacancies are there in the MHRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice announces 13 posts of Lecturer in the Institute of Pharmacy attached to Government Medical Colleges: UR 8, OBC/MOBC 4, ST (P) 1, with 3 posts reserved for women. The number may vary due to administrative exigencies.

faq.question: Q2. When do applications start for MHRB Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The notice advises applicants to visit https://nhm.assam.gov.in from 02/12/2026. As of 28 November 2026 that date has not yet arrived.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the MHRB Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online application is 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 250 for General category and Rs. 150 for OBC/MOBC/SC/ST (P)/ST (H) candidates. Candidates having a BPL certificate or PWD certificate need not pay. The fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the MHRB Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should be not less than 21 years and not more than 38 years of age as on 01/01/2026. The upper limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC/MOBC and 10 years for PWD.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for the MHRB Lecturer post?
faq.answer: First class in both B. Pharm and M. Pharm or First class in Pharm.D from a PCI recognized institution; or First class in B. Pharm with 3 years of teaching and research experience from a PCI recognized institution. Registration with the Assam Pharmacy Council is required.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a Lecturer under MHRB?
faq.answer: The scale of pay is Rs. 57,700/- to Rs. 1,82,400/- per month (Academic Level-10).

faq.question: Q8. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the pay scale is plus other allowances as admissible under Rules.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection procedure will be notified later by issuing a Notice. The Board will decide it on the basis of the number of applications received.

faq.question: Q10. Do candidates have to upload certificates with the online application?
faq.answer: No. Candidates need not submit testimonials or certificates with the online application. They must produce originals and self-attested copies at the time of interview.
